newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 ends down as record run hits buffers.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 ends down as record run hits buffers.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 index closed slightly lower on Wednesday as the market's record-breaking post-election surge finally showed signs of running out of steam.

Ending an unpredecented eight-session run of record closing highs, and finishing lower for the first time in the 12 sessions since the May 1 election, the blue chip index closed 4.1 points lower at 4,686.9.
Analysts and dealers said the market was due a period of consolidation after its 7.2 percent advance since the start of the month but more gains were on the cards in the medium term.
